layout: One entirely handwritten terminology index. Underlined title at upper right; terms in a broad left column and page references toward the right. The first entry starts near the upper edge, and the final authored entry lies about three quarters down the sheet. There are raised additions primitive and test category, a raised map of objects insertion with a curved connector, three cancelled text/numeral clusters, two cancelled small square drawings and their cancelled 34. A brace groups the two modelizer lines; tall closing parentheses group the basic/elementary, aspheric and local pairs. The modelizer reference 28 branches by two arrows to individually underlined 41 and 42. Underlines also occur at Terminology, reference 39 after 26, Strict, the phrase following locally, and Weak equivalence. A separate pencil archive 8 is in the lower-left corner; no intrinsic page number is visible. All authored text appears in the same hand. Whole image viewed exactly once, then each supplied half exactly once; fourteen unresolved loci were recorded and cropped once each.

notes: The sheet is a terminology list, not a proof or a continuous exposition. Its heading is Terminology; no date, intrinsic page number or stated page count appears. The archive pencil 8 is excluded from the text and recorded as a comment.
Reference ownership near the upper third is Coherator 13, Hot-equivalence 25, test category 26 and underlined 39, then test-topology 27. H shifts the first two later reference groups upward.
The raised sign by 29 is transcribed as a crossed superscript 7. No interpretation as a mathematical power, annotation index or plus has been supplied.

The single quote before basic has no mate. The dot in test. and the dot after the reference for [strict] elementary modelizer are retained. Exclamation marks and the final question-mark reference are retained.

The aspheric insertion reads map of objects. Its large curved return stroke joins the original closing-parenthesis region and is treated as an insertion connector. It is not duplicated as an additional textual closing parenthesis.
The first l after a in locally is heavily retraced. The final word locally is legible; the close crop does not yield a distinct earlier glyph, so no invented deleted letter is supplied.

The weak-equivalence fragment keeps the unclosed opening parenthesis. The short written form after Y is m; and is not expanded to map. The dash/arrow ambiguity remains marked despite the morphism-like context.

H emph at Strict and the numerical references is treated as underline, as its page note permits; macro-only representation differences are not counted. H descriptions and notes were considered when deciding whether a state was already marked.

Coverage is line by line from title through the final [locally] entry. The inventory includes every list line, each raised addition, each deletion, both drawings and their cancellations, all grouping marks, the reference-arrow diagram and the archive number. The C TikZ drawing and its explicit crossing strokes are retained where confirmed.

No substantive mathematical proof or computation was performed. The page supplies terms and references, not assertions to prove; the potentially non-parsing f : X-Y fragment was rechecked on its crop and left explicitly uncertain.
